correctness.rationale: Translation invariance makes the projection a convolution with D_{4,N}/N; its ℓ∞ and ℓ1 norms equal the normalized ℓ1 size of the kernel by phase-aligned input and a normalized point mass. The factorization |D_{4,N}(j)|=4|cos(πj/N) cos(2πj/N)| splits at the quarter-period zero on the half-grid. Product-to-sum and the exact finite cosine progression give the displayed master formula with u=π/(2N), q=floor((N−1)/4), r=2q+1 and T=csc for odd N or cot for even N. The residue-specific closed expressions permit Taylor expansions: negative −2π(2sqrt(2)+1)/(3N²) for N≡0, positive 2π(sqrt(2)−1)/(3N²) for N≡2, positive π(sqrt(2)+2)/(6N²) for odd N, with appropriate stated remainders. The continuous integral is 8(2sqrt(2)−1)/(3π). Independently compared the closed formula with direct |D| kernel sums for all N=4..1000; the analytic trigonometric sum proves every N.
residual_risks: Expansion coefficient derivations were checked from the displayed closed forms, not replaced by mesh extrapolation.
